ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: At the bottom of the figure is a common wire; the left node is labeled a, and the upper right node is labeled b. Node a is connected to the bottom common wire through a 1 Ω resistor. Between node a and node b there is a 1 A current source, with the arrow pointing from a to b. Node b is also connected to the bottom common wire through a 1 Ω resistor, and on the right side there is a 2 V voltage source connected between node b and the bottom common wire; the voltage source is marked with the upper end negative and the lower end positive. Reasoning: Take the bottom common wire as 0 V. The lower end of the right-side 2 V voltage source is positive and grounded, so the upper-end node b is 2 V lower than the bottom, so V_b = -2 V. Write KCL for node a: node a is connected only to the left 1 Ω resistor and the 1 A current source pointing from a to b. Taking the current leaving node a as positive, there is V_a/1Ω + 1 A = 0, so V_a = -1 V. Thus U_ab = V_a - V_b = (-1 V) - (-2 V) = 1 V.

method.method_draft: Take the bottom conductor as 0 V. From the right voltage source polarity, the top node b is 2 V below the bottom node, so V_b = -2 V. Apply KCL at node a: the only two elements connected to a are the left 1 Ω resistor to ground and the 1 A current source directed from a to b, so V_a/1Ω + 1 A = 0, giving V_a = -1 V. Therefore U_ab = V_a - V_b = (-1) - (-2) = 1 V.

method.method_draft: Apply superposition. First keep only the 2 V source and open the 1 A current source: node a is connected only to the bottom rail through 1 Ω, so V_a = 0, while the voltage source fixes V_b = -2 V; contribution to U_ab is 0 - (-2) = 2 V. Next keep only the 1 A current source and short the 2 V source: node b is at the bottom-node potential, so V_b = 0; KCL at node a gives V_a/1Ω + 1 A = 0, so V_a = -1 V; contribution to U_ab is -1 - 0 = -1 V. Sum the contributions: U_ab = 2 V + (-1 V) = 1 V.

按指定方法用叠加定理：
1. 只保留 2 V 电压源，打开 1 A 电流源。此时节点 a 只通过 1 Ω 电阻接到底部公共节点，因此 V_a = 0。电压源下端为正、上端为负，若底部公共节点取 0 V，则节点 b 电位 V_b = -2 V。所以这一部分对 U_ab 的贡献为 0 - (-2) = 2 V。
2. 只保留 1 A 电流源，短路 2 V 电压源。此时节点 b 被短接到底部公共节点，所以 V_b = 0。对节点 a 写 KCL：经 1 Ω 电阻流向地的电流为 V_a/1 Ω，电流源从 a 向 b 送出 1 A，因此 V_a/1 Ω + 1 A = 0，得到 V_a = -1 V。所以这一部分对 U_ab 的贡献为 -1 - 0 = -1 V。
3. 叠加两部分：U_ab = 2 V + (-1 V) = 1 V。
